capabilities: Enable the ELK renderer for Mermaid diagrams
Select ELK per diagram by prepending a directive to the diagram code
disambiguation: Not a diagram editor or drawing tool; it only changes the layout algorithm used to render Mermaid diagrams.
extras: The README is minimal: it explains only how to switch a diagram to ELK and credits the upstream library; there are no screenshots, examples or troubleshooting notes.
intentEvidence: This plugins brings back support for the elk (eclipse layout kernel) renderer for mermaidJS.
motivation: The README only says it "brings back" ELK support, implying it was removed elsewhere; no explicit motivation is stated.
problem: Obsidian's Mermaid support no longer ships the ELK renderer, so users who prefer its diagram layout cannot use it.
summary: Mermaid renderer add-on that restores the ELK (Eclipse Layout Kernel) layout engine for Mermaid diagrams in the vault.
